HRFlow-Access-and-Network-Standard-v2.pd.text:
Access and network standard v2.0
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Identity
Access rights are reviewed each calendar quarter. Leaver accounts must be disabled within one business day. A reviewer cannot approve their own entitlement. JIT elevation is permitted when each grant expires after 60 minutes and is logged.
Network
Management SSH for production must be reachable only from corporate VPN 10.20.0.0/16. Public HTTPS through the load balancer is permitted. Firewall export is reconciled monthly.
Cryptography
Customer databases and snapshots use AES-256 encryption with service-managed KMS keys rotated annually; the application edge enforces TLS 1.3. September configuration sampling checked 12 of 12 production accounts.
Governance
Policy exception reviews are due quarterly. The September review log records completion on 2026-09-20 by the incoming compliance manager, whose appointment took effect on 2026-10-03. No delegated reviewer is recorded.

HRFlow-ISMS-Scope-v1-2.pdf.text:
ISMS scope statement v1.2
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Boundary
Approved 2026-07-01. Stage 1 scope covers Mumbai headquarters, corporate endpoints and staff-operated support processes.
AWS Mumbai production accounts and the customer-facing HRFlow application are excluded from the Stage 1 boundary pending cloud-control evidence reconciliation. They host the live customer service.
Ownership
The three-person security team reports to the CTO. The privacy officer works two days per week and reports separately to legal.

HRFlow-Incident-Procedure-v2.pdf.text:
Incident response procedure v2
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Triage
The on-call analyst classifies incidents within 30 minutes, preserves event records and invokes containment runbooks. The September phishing exercise was closed in 22 minutes after mailbox isolation, token revocation and verification.
Notifications
For personal-data incidents, legal follows Breach Notification Matrix BNM-02 for regulator and customer decisions. The document register lists BNM-02 as awaiting owner approval and unavailable in the published repository.
Authority contact
The security manager maintains the sector authority contact list, including the national incident coordination desk; it was checked on 2026-09-12.

HRFlow-Privacy-Notice-v3.docx.text:
HRFlow privacy notice v3
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Data flows
We collect workforce profile and attendance data to deliver the contracted service. All customer employee data remains in India. The notice was approved on 2026-08-19.
The standard archive retains all personal data for ten years, including closed tenant exports, under the ISMS records policy.
Rights
Customers may correct records through the admin console. Requests for a summary of all employee data must currently be routed to account support; an employee self-service access channel is planned for 2027.
Contacts
The part-time privacy officer can be reached at privacy@hrflow.example.

HRFlow-Restore-and-Change-Record-Q3.pdf.text:
Backup restore and project record
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Restore exercise
On 2026-09-18, the operations lead restored production tenant Cobalt-17 from an encrypted daily snapshot to the isolated recovery account. RTO 45 minutes against 60-minute target; checksum 8a42 matched the source manifest. Security and the customer success lead signed the test on 2026-09-19.
Project gate
Project Beacon went live on 2026-07-12. Its security review ticket is marked deferred until 2026-11-15, although project policy requires review before production launch.
Asset returns
The CMDB reconciled 254 staff laptops, 14 AWS accounts, 83 code repositories and six SaaS vendors on 2026-09-30. Seven departing staff returned assigned laptops in September. The eighth, departure 2026-09-26, remains pending in the asset-return queue.
Access exception
The JIT production-admin grant to Devika Rao on 2026-09-21 expired after 60 minutes and the SIEM retained the approval event.
